site.audience: general public, donors, volunteers, disaster-affected communities

brief.title: Global Aid Alliance — Together We Respond
brief.one_liner: A humanitarian nonprofit organization dedicated to disaster relief, emergency assistance, and community resilience worldwide.
brief.goal: Inform the public about the organization's mission, drive donations, recruit volunteers, and provide resources for disaster preparedness and response.

pages.objective: Serve as the main landing page introducing the organization, showcasing impact, highlighting current relief efforts, and encouraging donations and volunteer sign-ups.

interactions.trigger: Click hamburger menu icon on mobile
interactions.expected: Mobile navigation drawer slides open revealing main nav links

interactions.trigger: Click Donate Now button in hero section
interactions.expected: Donation form or modal appears with amount selection options

interactions.trigger: Click next/previous arrows on news section
interactions.expected: News cards carousel advances to show next set of stories

interactions.trigger: Click on a program category heading
interactions.expected: Accordion expands to reveal program details and links

data_display.description: Key organizational impact metrics displayed prominently to build trust and demonstrate scale of operations.
List of core programs and services offered by the organization.
Latest news stories and updates about ongoing relief efforts and organizational activities.
